title: Mere bhai asghar
body:
ye kehti thi bali sakina tadap kar
udhar bezaban ko na le jao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bichad jayega mujhse mera baradar
udhar bezuban ko na le jao baba
<<DIVIDER>>
wo maqtal hai ran hai wo karbobala hai
wahan jo gaya wo wahin reh gaya hai
wahan se na laute shabihe payambar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo tum chaahte ho ke mil jaye pani
ke ho door bete ki tashna dahani
to pani ko qaime mein le aao jaa kar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tehar jao baba zara meri khaatir
mai jaane doo tumko wahan kaise aakhir
nazar har taraf aa rahe hai sitamgar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye gham kamsini mein uthaungi kaise
nigahon se mai dekh paaungi kaise
tadapte huwe is ko jalti zameen par
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
pata hai ye mujhko ke mar jayega ye
wahan se palat kar nahi aayega ye
tum aaoge is ko lehad mein chupa kar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam dhayenge bezaban pe wo kaafir
karega koi taygh se waar ya phir
lagega koi teer gardan pe aa kar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
bade be-rehm hai wo zaalim ay baba
samajhte nahi hai wo dil ka madawa
wo khush honge baysheer ka khoon baha kar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
meri baat baba khudara suno na
jo dekhegi maa bezaban ka bichona
to ghut ghut ke mar jayegi meri madar
udhar bezuban ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
shah e deen ke aazar aamir ayan thay
kumail us ghadi sheh ke aansoo rawan thay
ke sarwar se kehti thi jab bint e sarwar
udhar bezuban ko...
author: Kumail Jafri
